user.title: Add a lynx
user.description: Enter the camera's address and its device token. The token was shown on the setup page; the serial command `token` prints it too ([where to find it]({token_help})).

data_description.host: The camera's address, e.g. lynx-42e0.local or 192.168.1.40.
data_description.token: 32 characters, from the setup page or the serial `token` command.

zeroconf_confirm.title: lynx found on your network
zeroconf_confirm.description: {name} is at {host}. Enter its device token to add it ([where to find it]({token_help})).

reauth_confirm.title: New token for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected its token; it may have been rotated with `token new`. Enter the current one ([where to find it]({token_help})).

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the camera at that address.
error.not_lynx: That address answered, but it isn't a lynx.
error.unknown: Unexpected error talking to the camera.

abort.already_configured: This lynx is already set up.
abort.not_lynx: This device isn't a lynx (or runs firmware older than 0.3.0).
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different lynx.

look.name: Look
look.description: Moves the camera head to an absolute position with an eased, natural motion.

pan.name: Pan
pan.description: Degrees; 0 is straight ahead, positive turns to the camera's left.

tilt.name: Tilt
tilt.description: Degrees; 0 points the lens straight up, 45 is the rest pose.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Milliseconds for the move; leave empty to pick from the distance.
